title: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST……
description: An insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists in the DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint. Authenticated attackers can supply another user's uid to obtain that user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials without proper verification. This allows unauthorized access to live video, microphone audio, camera speaker, and stored recordings of Meari-backed cameras.
